title: Waverly at Watersound
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘Waverly at Watersound’ a Luxury 5 Bedroom, 5.5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 12 guests, this home offers a private pool, rooftop terrace with Gulf views, Golf Cart & Bikes!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Watersound is a Gated Community with deeded beach access, community pools, and restaurants. • Multiple Balconies & Observation Tower with Gulf Views • Heated Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day from October 1 - May 1) • 3 Stories & 4,478 Square Feet • 4-Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12) FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 2) • Bedroom 1: Guest King Suite (sleeps 2) and ensuite bathroom with single vanity and tile shower SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 6) • Bedroom 2: Bunk Room (sleeps 4) two custom twin over twin bunks and ensuite bathroom with single vanity, shower/tub combination • Bedroom 3: Guest Suite (sleeps 2) two twin beds and ensuite bathroom with single vanity, tile/glass shower + private balcony THIIRD FLOOR (Sleeps 2) • Bedroom 4: Primary King Suite (sleeps 2) and ensuite bathroom with double vanities, walk-in glass/tile shower, modern soaking tub + private balcony Carriage House (Sleeps 2) • Bedroom 5: Guest King Suite (sleeps 2) and ensuite bathroom with single vanity and tile shower DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Waverly at Watersound, a masterpiece of coastal elegance tucked behind the private gates of the exclusive Watersound Beach community. This exquisite retreat is a harmonious blend of refined luxury and natural beauty, offering sophisticated travelers an unparalleled experience along Florida’s iconic 30A. With a main residence, a private carriage house, a serene pool, and an elevated tower boasting sweeping views of the Emerald Coast, every detail of this home has been thoughtfully curated to provide a haven of tranquility and indulgence. Step into the main house and be captivated by soaring 20-foot ceilings and a living space that invites relaxation amidst calming views of the surrounding nature preserve. The chef’s kitchen, outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances and an expansive island with bar seating, sets the stage for gourmet gatherings, while the adjoining dining area and screened-in porch offer serene spaces to enjoy meals or unwind. Generous accommodation includes a first-floor king guest suite, a whimsical bunk room, and a second-floor twin bedroom, each with its own private bath, culminating in the opulent third-floor master suite, where Gulf-view balconies and a spa-like ensuite redefine luxury. The separate carriage house is a retreat in itself, offering a private sanctuary complete with a king bed, ensuite bath, and breezy balcony. Outside, the private pool beckons for sunlit afternoons and tranquil evenings under the stars. Located just steps from a golf cart-accessible beach path and moments from the Dunesider Grill, community pools, and the vibrant energy of The Big Chill, Waverly at Watersound delivers effortless access to the pristine beaches and world-class amenities that define this exclusive stretch of 30A. Whether savoring the panoramic Gulf views from the tower or indulging in the privacy and comfort of this meticulously designed home, Waverly at Watersound promises a stay of unmatched sophistication and timeless coastal charm. LAYOUT: FIRST FLOOR: • Main Living Area with Fireplace • Dining Room (seats 8) • Chef's dream kitchen with 6 burner range, oversized fridge, convection microwave & dishwasher • Large Island (seats 4) • Screened in Porch • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bath • Half Bath • Laundry Room with Sink SECOND FLOOR: • Media Room • Bunk Room & ensuite bath • Guest Suite with two twins & ensuite bath • Balcony THIRD FLOOR: • Primary Suite with ensuite bath • Loft Office Space • Balcony CARRIAGE HOUSE: • King Guest Suite with ensuite bath OUTDOOR AREA: • Private Heated Pool • Observation tower with seating • Outdoor Shower • Multiple Balconies CONVENIENT LOCATION: • The Big Chill (0.5 Miles) • Alys Beach (3 Miles) • Rosemary Beach (3.9 Miles) • Seacrest Beach (3.5 Miles) • Seagrove Beach (3.5 Miles) • Seaside (5 Miles)
